in_hebrew.name: רענולד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words 'ra'anan' which means counselor and 'el' which means God. The name Reynold is derived from the Hebrew and means 'Counselor of God'.

in_greek.name: Ραινωλδος
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek words 'rhein' which means counselor and 'dunamis' which means power. The name Reynold is derived from the Greek and means 'Counselor of Power'.

in_latin.name: Reinaldus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Old German words 'hrei' which means counsel and 'wald' which means ruler. The name Reynold is derived from the Old German and means 'Counsel-Ruler'.
